name: Old Corkscrew Golf Club
sourceLabel: Final published layout checked against FSGA ratings and the official closure notice
cardNote: This preserves the played Old Corkscrew layout as historical course data. The club officially ended daily operations in 2026 and the property is being rebuilt as Pandion Club; this pack must not imply current playability. Six exact per-hole rows reconcile to the published totals and FSGA ratings. All 18 original numbered routes carry matching pars.
